Setext Title
============

Text under a Setext level-one heading. Renderers treat the underline as making the line above it a heading.

Setext Section
--------------

Text under a Setext level-two heading.

> ## Note
>
> A heading inside a blockquote, as callouts are often converted.

> **Warning:** not a heading, just bold text in a quote.

- ## Heading in a list item

Paragraph text followed by a thematic break.

---

## ATX after Setext

Final section with an ATX heading.
